svg.title: 08 Contract storage and AWS orchestration
svg.text: Contract storage and run orchestration in AWS
Revision 3 target · not deployed locally. Python interprets contracts; Snowflake stores state and executes SQL formulas.
Authoring: Vue admin or optional Git CI
Mutable authoring; exact revision to publish
No function DDL in publication transaction
Read exact revision; verify canonical hash
Mark delivered only after send ACK
Delete queue message after result commit
Recheck run owner / fencing token / lease
Complete Silver or Gold + lineage + traces
Guard scenario pointer by draft + selected run
Review Gold; finish, edit or chain
New draft → new run; retry → same plan
Rollback: no partial Silver or Gold
Persist attempt error and retry budget
Old generations cannot claim or publish
Existing direct copy; one row per event id
ACK each successful entry; retry failures
Consumers deduplicate by stable event ID
Stage 2 · when multi-step state is needed
Activities call the same idempotent run API
Choose one retry owner per layer
No engine is deployed in this package
FIFO deduplication lasts five minutes. Relay retries reuse dispatchId; deliberate retry/recovery uses a new dispatchId and generation.
Queue order is not database ownership. Prove control-table uniqueness and concurrency; fence stale workers and guard scenario result pointers.
AWS deployment: API / relay / worker credentials via Secrets Manager; Snowflake region alignment and PrivateLink where required and supported.
